Make your own galaxy picture

Real, calibrated SDSS images in three filters. Every choice that turns them into a colour picture is a control on this page: the stretch, what counts as white, which filter goes to which colour, or none of that, and the colours a human eye would see instead.

Hover over the picture to read out a pixel.
